comment: Share-lists for the plugin host's SharedAssemblyPolicy. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH consumed by App.Common/Bootstrap.cs (runtime) AND tools/bundles/stage_bundle.py (bundle staging). excludedExactMatches come from collectible-bundles.json at runtime. POLARITY FLIPPED 2026-07-11 (bundle-maximalism phase-0 completion): the broad FantaSim.App. prefix is gone — shared = T1 contracts (enumerated exactMatches; the runtime SharedAssemblyPolicy has no suffix-rule support) + the resident floor. Floor entries: App.Common/App.Resource/App.Resource.Bundle.Seam are PERMANENT (target-topology RESIDENT line); App.Ecs until phase 7, App.NodeGraph + App.Ui.NodeGraph until phase 3 — droppable only when the corresponding complete-app.csproj ProjectReference goes (unsharing while the host still loads them = cross-ALC dual-copy, the MessagePack type-split class). DynamicData prefix removed DELIBERATELY (not dead cleanup): its only consumer is bundle-local App.World.FieldView and no resident copy ever existed — it now stages into world.pck, fixing a latent resolution gap. netstandard prefix stays: facade-name resolution requests from netstandard-targeted shared assemblies (UnifyMaths et al.) can hit it at runtime even with no matching file on disk. App.Timeline.Seam added tunnel-slice-1 (2026-07-11): host-composition-resident (complete-app.csproj direct ProjectReference), and App.Presentation (world bundle) now references its tunnel pure-math + filmstrip-sink classes — the bundle must resolve the SAME resident copy, not a bundled duplicate (the flip's structural rule applied to a new bundle->resident edge). Its transitive closure pulls three more resident assemblies into bundle deps (caught by --check-dual at Task 6): App.Command (PERMANENT floor per target topology), App.Ui.Seam + App.Ui (floor until phase 4 moves them to the ui bundle) — same structural rule.

common.comment: Assemblies packed into common.pck (resident layer, Default ALC, packaging granularity only). Stripped from the exported exe by tools/bundles/strip_common_from_export.py. First-cut list per the 2026-07-08 design brief §E; Godot-facing candidates are detector-vetoed (E1). ReactiveUI/DynamicData/BoomHud.Foundation from the brief's list are NOT in the real host closure (verified 2026-07-08) and were dropped.
